title: Figure 39: Diagram of a Celestial Sphere
description: Geometric diagram of a celestial sphere centered on "Earth", showing the Horizon, the Equator, the zenith (Z), the north point (N) and a point S. Arcs between them are labeled with angular quantities "90-Lat", "90-δ" and "Ha" (hour angle), with an angle "B" marked at the zenith, apparently for computing the sun's position. Caption: "FIGURE 39 DIAGRAM OF A CELESTIAL SPHERE"; drawing A-7535, page 56.
